x: Our next two, Garland and Sanders, were fighting hard to keep their positions and we knew there was a prospect of our team getting placed. But we were disappointed, as on reckoning up the team scores, we were bracketed third with Fitzroy Lodge, who gained the position on a better aggregate time for their four.

Our junior team of runners, Messrs Garland, Jacobs, Clubb and Thorne, by dead-heating in the Surrey Youths' Race with Mitcham A.C., showed that our younger members may be relied upon to uphold Belgrave prestige, and in time will prove worthy successors of the present seniors
On the return of the runners they were headed by Gittings, of South London H. with Garland in fifth position, an improvement on his running in the same race last year.
Kench, Jones, Garland and Ford, were third in the final of the Under 19 Relay, beaten by Herne Hill H. and Polytechnic H.; and R.
Garland. Something went wrong at the bend in the first heat and Garland and Hyde fell, which, of course, knocked both of them out of the final.
Beaumont, off 65, went in front, only to be passed in the last few yards by S. Garland, off 42. The final placings were: Garland, Beaumont, Shields, with W.
